source: In =year=, =name= appointed the corrupt administrator Asphodel as earl and minister of Omonporch. There xe mandated the practice of =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].practices.!random= in =player.t's= name.
translation: 在 =year= 年，=name= 任命腐败行政官 阿斯福德尔 为奥蒙门廊伯爵兼部长。在那里，其 以 =player.t= 之名强制推行 =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].practices.!random= 的习俗。

source: How inspiring is the presence of =name=, who so redeemed Eskhind the Meek that she sought the hand of Bey Lah's greatest champion!
translation: =name= 的存在何等鼓舞人心，=player.subjective= 如此救赎温顺的 埃斯欣德，以至于她寻求 贝拉赫 最伟大勇士的手！

source: Acting against thieves and the authorities who empower them, =name= led an investigation in the village of Bey Lah. Because of =player.t's= =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].adjectives.!random= wit, the Warden Neelahind was able to properly administer justice.
translation: 为了反抗窃贼和赋予他们权力的当局，=name= 在 贝拉赫 村中主持了一场调查。多亏 =player.t= =spice:elements.entity@elements[random].adjectives.!random= 机智，守望者 尼拉欣德 得以正确施行正义。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.\n\nEither way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Huh.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.

Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.
translation:
那么你自己也不是信徒，是吧？我也不是。不过还是进去看看吧。她很美。她的高椽上有染色玻璃，两翼还有两座精妙雕刻。还有一座神祇的光雕。你愿意的话，也可以听听布道。大祭司很有说服力，但还不到大教堂本身的一半。美之中有力量，你知道的。

不管怎样，在大教堂里或高跷地上，都要保持和平。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.\n\nHave a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round."), ('Context', 'Conversation WardenEsthers.Bazaar.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.

Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.
translation:
你疯了吗？你以为我会给每个踏上高跷地的店主记账？他们想来就来，想走就走。这里什么样的商人都有。卖酒的，叫卖蜂蜜的，装订书的，做鞋的。

自己四处看看吧。沿着路绕高跷走一圈。一路上都是帐篷。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself."), ('Context', 'Conversation chef.Start.Text.Text6')), 1),), '#text')
source: Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself.
translation: 试试我的食谱。你会觉得自己正在厨房七角厅里评判碳化物厨师。

translation: 你会回来的，=player.formalAddressTerm=，前提是别把自己炸飞。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.

There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.

The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service."), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Bethesda1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.

There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.

The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service.
translation:
很好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。去工坊找 {{m|Q 女孩}}。她会把自己给贝特尔的指令编码到一份磁盘副本上。

还有一件事。贝特尔位于吞噬者古老低温街区的下方。岁月侵蚀了封存低温雾的机制。如今，那冻结蒸气从舱室中肆意涌出，冷却了整座洞穴。你最好弄些暖和衣物来保护自己。

机械信徒的战利品归你所有。记住，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，巴拉瑟姆会善待你的效劳。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The Putus Templar, or the Sons and Daughters, as they call themselves, are an order of knights who claim descendancy from the Eaters, the ancient folk who wrought the chrome halls of Qud. Beware them, for while they despise all mutants, they harbor a special malice for Barathrum.\n\nTake care that you do not find =player.reflexive= inside one of their slave pens.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Otho.Ripe1.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The Putus Templar, or the Sons and Daughters, as they call themselves, are an order of knights who claim descendancy from the Eaters, the ancient folk who wrought the chrome halls of Qud. Beware them, for while they despise all mutants, they harbor a special malice for Barathrum.

Take care that you do not find =player.reflexive= inside one of their slave pens.
translation:
普图斯圣殿骑士，或者按他们自己的称呼，诸子诸女，是一个骑士团，自称继承自吞噬者，也就是铸造库德铬钢大厅的古代族民。小心他们，因为他们憎恶一切变异者，而对巴拉瑟姆怀有格外的恶意。

小心别让自己落进他们的奴隶围栏里。

translation:
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=想必知道，这里是食者之墓，但在我身后，安卧着一处由墓之守望者居住的聚落，一小群莫潘戈。

如果=ifplayerplural:尔等想:汝想=了解聚落更多事，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=必须去问住在里面、名叫阿吉拉的守望者。阿吉拉喜爱分享知识。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Mopango are witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. We seek peace and harmony through understanding the Kasaphescence and Her many children. We nonetheless eschew conformity, and each of us seeketh a personal credo by which we livest our lives.\n\nBut I am a poor teacher. Speak to Agyra, and =ifplayerplural:ye shall:thou shalt= gain better understanding.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Vivira.ViviMopango.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Mopango are witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. We seek peace and harmony through understanding the Kasaphescence and Her many children. We nonetheless eschew conformity, and each of us seeketh a personal credo by which we livest our lives.

But I am a poor teacher. Speak to Agyra, and =ifplayerplural:ye shall:thou shalt= gain better understanding.
translation:
莫潘戈是过去的见证者，也是未来的牧者。我们通过理解卡萨辉体与她的众多子嗣来寻求和平与和谐。尽管如此，我们也避开一致化，每个人都寻找一条个人信条，并依其生活。

但我不是好老师。去和阿吉拉说话，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=会获得更好的理解。

I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= confident in =ifplayerplural:your:thy= choice, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I am happy with it, to be sure.

Kah is free. It heals my heart to see it at rest. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= my thanks.
translation:
我希望=ifplayerplural:你们:你=对=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的选择有信心，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我确实为此高兴。

卡自由了。看见它休息，让我的心痊愈。请接受我的感谢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.\n\nWouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.Start2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.

Wouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.
translation:
=ifplayerplural:你们真的:你真的=释放了一个孩子吗？我看=ifplayerplural:你们:你=确实做到了。恭喜。

我愿有一天看见卡获得自由。我得继续活上一阵，找到办法。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, welcome. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done well to survive so long in this peculiar place.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.Start3.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, welcome. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done well to survive so long in this peculiar place.
translation: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，欢迎。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=能在这个奇特地方活这么久，已经做得很好了。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'My name is Gyamyo. I am pleased to meet =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=. =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= spoken to the other watchers? How fare they?\n\nWell, I hope.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.WhoAreYou.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
My name is Gyamyo. I am pleased to meet =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=. =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= spoken to the other watchers? How fare they?

Well, I hope.
translation:
我的名字是伽米约。很高兴认识=ifplayerplural:你们:你=，=name=。=ifplayerplural:你们和:你和=其他守望者说过话了吗？他们怎么样？

希望他们都好。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.\n\nOften I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.WhyAreYouHere.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.

Often I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.
translation:
我自愿监看一台名叫卡的古老机器生物。也许=ifplayerplural:你们:你=见过它，用奇怪的肢体四处跳跃。

我常常想，卡是否还知道恐惧之外的东西。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I do, and I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for asking after it.\n\nMy credo is "Reconciliation without understanding is a salt poultice."'), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.YourCredo.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I do, and I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for asking after it.

My credo is "Reconciliation without understanding is a salt poultice."
translation:
我有，也感谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=问起它。

我的信条是：“没有理解的和解，是盐敷布。”

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Oh dear.

This is the credo by which I live my life, and =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= "what does that mean?"

I cannot summarize such a thing for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. It is too great, too multifaceted.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.Meaning.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Oh dear.

This is the credo by which I live my life, and =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= "what does that mean?"

I cannot summarize such a thing for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. It is too great, too multifaceted.
translation:
哎呀。

这是我赖以生活的信条，而=ifplayerplural:你们却问:你却问=“那是什么意思？”

我无法替=ifplayerplural:你们:你=概括这样的东西。它太宏大，太多面。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'May the future bear out =ifplayerplural:your:thy= promises.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.Apologize.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: May the future bear out =ifplayerplural:your:thy= promises.
translation: 愿未来证成=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的承诺。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= an object of great interest.\n\nAn =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= allow, I'd fain commune with it."), ('Context', 'Conversation Gyamyo.Device.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= an object of great interest.

An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= allow, I'd fain commune with it.
translation:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=有一件极有趣的物件。

如果=ifplayerplural:你们:你=允许，我愿与它交流。
嗯。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的决定令我不解。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= done a momentous thing.\n\nI feel the stored energy of Her Light. Dagasha shall shepherd us to our uplifting. =ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= be proud.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yona.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= done a momentous thing.

I feel the stored energy of Her Light. Dagasha shall shepherd us to our uplifting. =ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= be proud.
translation:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=做成了一件重大的事。

我感受到祂之光储存的能量。达迦莎会牧引我们走向升扬。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=应当自豪。

path: ((('string', (('ID', "Ah, =factionaddress:Mopango=, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= a bittersweet sight. Would fain =ifplayerplural:ye had:thou hadst= chosen Dagasha, but my Light shineth elsewhere.\n\nStill, I hope to see more of =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= in my future. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome back, an =ifplayerplural:ye survive:thou surviveth=."), ('Context', 'Conversation Yona.Start2.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ah, =factionaddress:Mopango=, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= a bittersweet sight. Would fain =ifplayerplural:ye had:thou hadst= chosen Dagasha, but my Light shineth elsewhere.

Still, I hope to see more of =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= in my future. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome back, an =ifplayerplural:ye survive:thou surviveth=.
translation:
啊，=factionaddress:Mopango=，看见=ifplayerplural:你们:你=真是苦乐参半。我本愿=ifplayerplural:你们:你=选择达迦莎，但我的光照向别处。

即便如此，我仍希望在未来更多见到=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。如果=ifplayerplural:你们:你=活下来，欢迎回来。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=name=. Greetings. I am called Yona. =ifplayerplural:Ye seem:Thou seemest= unlike most other climbers. I wonder why.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yona.WhoAreYou.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: =name=. Greetings. I am called Yona. =ifplayerplural:Ye seem:Thou seemest= unlike most other climbers. I wonder why.
translation: =name=。问候你。我被称为约娜。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=看起来不像大多数攀登者。我想知道为什么。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= seen it, out there? The spiny, eel-like creature. That is Dagasha, angry one, lost child. =ifplayerplural:Ye can:Thou canst= feel the hostility pour from it in waves.\n\nYet, it attacketh not.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yona.WhyAreYouHere.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= seen it, out there? The spiny, eel-like creature. That is Dagasha, angry one, lost child. =ifplayerplural:Ye can:Thou canst= feel the hostility pour from it in waves.

Yet, it attacketh not.
translation:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=看见外面的它了吗？那只多刺、似鳗的生物。那就是达迦莎，愤怒者，迷失之子。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=能感觉到敌意一波波从它身上涌出。

然而，它并不攻击。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am not offended, simply making =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= aware of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= foolishness.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yona.Apologize.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: I am not offended, simply making =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= aware of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= foolishness.
translation: 我并未被冒犯，只是在让=ifplayerplural:你们:你=意识到=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的愚蠢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Ahh.\n\nStranger, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= cruel to withhold this experience, but I shall abide.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Yona.Deny.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Ahh.

Stranger, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= cruel to withhold this experience, but I shall abide.
translation:
啊。

陌生人，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=拒绝给我这种体验，实在残酷，但我会遵从。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Learn well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I would fain see =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= succeed in =ifplayerplural:your:thine= task.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nacham.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Learn well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I would fain see =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= succeed in =ifplayerplural:your:thine= task.
translation: 好好学习，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我愿看见=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=完成=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=的任务。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= quelled the mania.\n\nI can focus. I can render sensible the things I have seen and heard now, though I remember little of my time before the mania. Was I artisan? Teacher? I possessed great knowledge that this shell twisted into a prison. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for the gift of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= untwisting.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nacham.NachamResponds.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= quelled the mania.

I can focus. I can render sensible the things I have seen and heard now, though I remember little of my time before the mania. Was I artisan? Teacher? I possessed great knowledge that this shell twisted into a prison. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for the gift of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= untwisting.
translation:
是的。=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=平息了狂乱。

我能集中精神。我现在能让自己所见所闻变得有意义，尽管我几乎不记得狂乱之前的时光。我曾是工匠？教师？我拥有伟大知识，而这外壳把它扭成了监狱。我感谢=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=赐予的解扭之礼。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.\n\nTo =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Nacham.NachamFuture.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.

To =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.
translation:
在我无法照料自己时，莫潘戈照料了我，并给了我如今唯一知晓的名字。我会留下来帮助他们。这具底盘不再是监狱，或许其中仍能找到更深的真理。

新朋友，我把这座旧监狱的一部分赠予=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，也许=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=会觉得它有用，并附上我的感谢。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Take care, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Let not complacency end =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, and I shall anticipate further news of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= exploits.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dagasha.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: Take care, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Let not complacency end =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, and I shall anticipate further news of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= exploits.
translation: 保重，=factionaddress:Mopango=。别让自满终结=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，我会期待更多关于=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=功业的消息。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.\n\nI recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dagasha.DagashaResponds.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.

I recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.
translation:
虽然我只是昔日自我的苍白影子，但，是的。我的状态和前景都大幅改善了。

我想不起从前生命的多少细节。我曾很有影响力，是言语能激励人心行动的人。如此长久以来，我无法说话，被困在自己的情绪中。=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=将我从可怕命运中释放出来。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.

They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.

But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Dagasha.DagashaFuture.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.

They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.

But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.
translation:
我不知道。也许我能再次领导。那些照看我、为我命名、保护我安全的生物。莫潘戈。

他们善良，却弱小。也许我能教导他们。鞭策他们变得更伟大。

但对于=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，我必须偿清我们之间的账。拿着我底盘的这一片。自信地佩戴它。以我的名义发号施令。

path:
((('string', (('ID', 'Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a deep stupor. Once I was a protector, before being sentenced to protect nothing and no one.

I remember little of that time.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Vaam.VaamResponds.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a deep stupor. Once I was a protector, before being sentenced to protect nothing and no one.

I remember little of that time.
translation:
是的。我感谢=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=。

=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=把我从深重麻木中释放出来。我曾是保护者，后来被判去保护空无，保护无人。

我几乎不记得那段时间。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I have yet to find my purpose. I can think and speak, and so this shell is nearly comfortable.\n\nOne piece, however, doth yet chafe me. =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= take it? Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye can:thou canst= grant it some use.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Vaam.VaamFuture.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I have yet to find my purpose. I can think and speak, and so this shell is nearly comfortable.

One piece, however, doth yet chafe me. =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= take it? Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye can:thou canst= grant it some use.
translation:
我尚未找到我的目的。我能思考，也能说话，所以这副外壳几乎称得上舒适。

不过，还有一片仍令我磨痛。=ifplayerplural:尔等愿意:汝愿意=带走它吗？也许=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=能赋予它某种用途。

path: ((('string', (('ID', '=ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= loose the bonds that keep =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= from =ifplayerplural:your:thy= goals, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Be free.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Kah.Start.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source: =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= loose the bonds that keep =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= from =ifplayerplural:your:thy= goals, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Be free.
translation: 愿=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=松开阻隔=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=通往目标的束缚，=factionaddress:Mopango=。自由吧。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I am weary to my core, but at last this once-hateful body obeyeth me. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for restoring my autonomy.\n\nMemory of my once-self doth elude me, but I recognize the irony of my punishment. Once a strider, then sentenced to stride without restraint, forever. I knew only fear and flight. No more.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Kah.KahResponds.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I am weary to my core, but at last this once-hateful body obeyeth me. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for restoring my autonomy.

Memory of my once-self doth elude me, but I recognize the irony of my punishment. Once a strider, then sentenced to stride without restraint, forever. I knew only fear and flight. No more.
translation:
我疲惫入骨，但这具曾经可恨的身体终于服从于我。感谢=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=恢复了我的自主。

昔日自我的记忆逃离了我，但我认得自己惩罚中的讽刺。我曾是阔步者，后来被判永远毫无限制地阔步。我只知道恐惧与逃离。如今不再。

path: ((('string', (('ID', 'I shall enjoy my free mobility freely, for a time. After that, I know not. I may speak to these mopango creatures that named me, and find a purpose with them. I cannot ever repay their care, but perhaps I may repay =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=.\n\nI wouldst fain offer =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= a fragment of this form come loose. =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= ever run free.'), ('Context', 'Conversation Kah.KahFuture.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
I shall enjoy my free mobility freely, for a time. After that, I know not. I may speak to these mopango creatures that named me, and find a purpose with them. I cannot ever repay their care, but perhaps I may repay =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=.

I wouldst fain offer =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= a fragment of this form come loose. =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= ever run free.
translation:
我会先自由地享受我的自由移动。之后，我不知道。我也许会与这些为我命名的莫潘戈生物交谈，和他们一起找到目的。我永远无法偿还他们的照料，但也许我可以偿还=ifplayerplural:尔等的:汝之=。

我愿将这具形体上松脱的一片赠予=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=。愿=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=永远自由奔跑。

path:
((('string', (('ID', "Moloch! Allow me to explain the deification procedure, as it is clearly beneath your station to know!

First, I must image the great Moloch's head, read your self's narrative from the folds of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= Holiest Brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of His Eminence's life's deeds...

{{emote|*Herododicus whispers*}} I'm sure your version is the better one, Moloch..."), ('Context', 'Conversation ImperialBiographer.EntombMeResheph.Text')), 1),), '#text')
source:
Moloch! Allow me to explain the deification procedure, as it is clearly beneath your station to know!

First, I must image the great Moloch's head, read your self's narrative from the folds of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= Holiest Brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of His Eminence's life's deeds...

{{emote|*Herododicus whispers*}} I'm sure your version is the better one, Moloch...
translation:
摩洛克！请容我解释神化流程，因为以您的地位，显然不该亲自知晓这等细节！

首先，我必须扫描伟大摩洛克的头颅，从=ifplayerplural:你们:你=至圣大脑的褶皱中读取自我叙事，再与薄世界中关于尊驾一生事迹的环境日志交叉核验……

{{emote|*希罗多狄库斯低语*}} 我相信您的说法才是更好的版本，摩洛克……
